segments.title: What do you actually get free?
segments.say: What do you actually get free? ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini.

segments.title: ChatGPT Free
segments.say: ChatGPT: unlimited everyday chats, search, uploads and images. Ads in some countries.

segments.title: Claude Free
segments.say: Claude: limits reset every five hours. Search, files, code and memory.

segments.title: Gemini Free
segments.say: Gemini: Deep Research, images and audio overviews. No video.

segments.title: Pick by what you need
segments.say: So: everyday chats, ChatGPT. Memory, Claude. Deep Research, Gemini.

segments.title: SAVE THIS
